name: Monster College
source:
The protagonist of this story discovers that he is a werewolf. Despite already attending a good university, he feels compelled to change it to enroll at Silverleaf University.

In his new life, he will meet beautiful women, each with their own fascinating peculiarities: demons, vampires, zombies, werewolves, gorgons...

[From [url=https://monstereyegames.itch.io/monster-college]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这个故事的主角发现自己是狼人。尽管他已经就读了一所好大学，但他还是觉得有必要改变自己的选择，去银叶大学就读。

在他的新生活中，他将遇到美丽的女人，每个女人都有自己迷人的特性：恶魔、吸血鬼、僵尸、狼人、蛇发女妖……

[来自[url=https://monstereyegames.itch.io/monster-college]Itch.io[/url]]
